description: Delta-neutral carry trade (funding arbitrage) analysis, with a profitable/marginal/loss verdict on top of the same math primitive.funding_arb uses. Prefer this over primitive.funding_arb whenever a plain-English verdict is wanted, not just the raw numbers. Use when user asks "is this carry trade worth it?": long on exchange A, short on exchange B, collect the funding rate spread. Returns: netYieldPct, grossProfit, netProfit, breakevenDays, verdict (profitable/marginal/loss).

funding_rate_long.description: Funding rate on long exchange per interval (decimal)

funding_rate_short.description: Funding rate on short exchange per interval (decimal)

name: workflow.run_carry_trade
